object: 1990s compact five-door hatchback: pressed sheet-steel body panels on a unibody shell, glass windows, plastic bumpers, steel wheels
understanding: Door skins, wings, bonnet and roof are thin sheet over a stiff frame; they dent between the pillars, sills and panel edges, which hold their shape.
Bumpers take low hits first; corners and doors collect dings; a heavy side impact pushes in a whole door; a rollover flattens the roof.
Hurt by parking knocks, door dings, hail, a crash on one corner, and years of standing outside.
Paint fades and wears on the bonnet, roof and edges; rust starts at the wheel arches, sills, door bottoms and around the windscreen.
